scope: Read-only source, planner and caller review; no edits, builds, tests or performance runs.
bec256: No source-contract blocker. NEON legality, V2 policy, pair carrier, argument order and independently bounded scratch adapters remain intact. The shared leaf tail is unchanged, with independent positions and populations. Empty read/write vector-register dependencies introduce no memory or ownership requirement.
tuplepack: No source-contract or correctness blocker. The <=1/3/7 route thresholds preserve the original table choice over prepare_read64's compacted chunks. Masks and bounded loads preserve holes, empty projections and source access. Rows=2/4 scattered fallbacks use the same point-row body; their active-address guards and subsequent selection/reordering remain intact.
tradeoff: Lookup/shift/mask logic is duplicated locally to preserve packet/write lowering. Four table widths by four output parts is bounded specialization. Performance and emitted-code costs remain for the complete-consumer comparison.
